content:

Source: https://www.biznes.gov.pl/pl/portal/006365
Tier: official

- The Biznes.gov.pl page outlines 2025–2026 changes in Polish labor law relevant to HR (kadry i płace), focusing on:
- December 2025: Free Christmas Eve (24 December) becomes a day off for employees.
- December 24, 2025 onward: Recruitment and job advertisements must be gender-neutral and non-discriminatory. Job titles should be usable by any gender (e.g., “asystent/a”).
- Salary transparency: Candidates must be informed of the full pay range or exact salary for the position, either in the job ad, before a qualifying interview, or before entering cooperation.
- Salary components: All pay elements must be disclosed (base pay, bonuses, and even in-kind/policy benefits like a company phone).
- Practical impact for HR and payroll (kadry i płace): update recruitment texts, ensure gender-neutral language, publish or share total compensation details early in the process, and...
